name: Bug report

title: ""
labels: "type:fix"
assignees: ""
---

## What happened

Describe the observable failure and name its public owner.

## Reproduction

List the smallest reproducible steps. Use synthetic values and public inputs.

## Expected behavior

State what should have happened instead.

## Environment

Include the relevant Sjel commit and operating system. Add the container runtime when it matters.
Do not include data that identifies a person or deployment; private hostnames and credentials are
never useful in a public reproduction.

## Evidence

Paste the smallest redacted error or log excerpt that proves the failure. If the report contains a
security vulnerability or cannot be safely redacted, stop and use [the private reporting
route](../../SECURITY.md).
